# Unmodified course package

Official repository: https://github.com/DomenSoberlFamnit/famnit-gym

Pinned commit: 0db0652ad3b8cece05d476c56637a3dcb56557cd (2026-11-02).

The included wheel is built directly from that snapshot with no source edits. Its MIT license is included. PROVENANCE.json records the wheel SHA-256 and critical source hashes. All other learning and reporting code is original Python standard-library code.

Upstream reused version 0.2 after changing Astronaut physics and random spawning. If updating an existing installation, force reinstall this wheel; a version-number-only check is insufficient:

    python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps vendor/famnit_gym-0.2-py3-none-any.whl

The program verifies the installed critical source hashes before creating an environment.
